# chain-of-title-compass — llms.txt

> Chain-of-Title Compass: answer "who owns what" from the rights source of
> truth — cite DOCUMENTED passport fields, refuse to assert PENDING ones.
> Advisory tooling only, NOT legal advice. Free lane, no credentials.
> License: MIT-0. Publisher: Cumulative Web Inc (hp@cumulativeweb.com).
> Install: `clawhub install cwi/chain-of-title-compass`

## Quickstart

```bash
clawhub install cwi/chain-of-title-compass
cd ~/.clawhub/skills/cwi/chain-of-title-compass
python3 scripts/passport_check.py
# PASSPORT OK: Zooted Zone (CHAIN-OF-TITLE COMPASS) — DOCUMENTED fields cited, PENDING named
```

Then read SKILL.md for the rights-question procedure and HEARTBEAT cadence.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- Rights Passports: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/compass/passports.json (format cwi-compass/v1, 24 passports)
- Item card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/compass/item-card.json
- Rubric: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/compass/rubric.json
- Gear registry: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/gear.json
- Agent card (this skill): ./agent-card.json

## Rules

- DOCUMENTED = cite verbatim with source. PENDING = "Undocumented — [what's missing], provided by [provided_by]."
- Never fill a PENDING field from general knowledge or memory.
- Passports file 404s → stop; do not answer rights questions from memory.
- Repeat the advisory disclaimer whenever the answer leaves your session.
- HEARTBEAT: re-fetch passports.json daily; never answer from a copy older than 24h.

- sync-readiness $0.25/call (USDC, Base Sepolia testnet; no public URL published yet — operator self-hosts).
